# VegetationStats

Kind: context · Defined in [`src/logic/vegetation/vegetation.h`](../../../src/logic/vegetation/vegetation.h) · Described in `data/world.json`

Host context variable written by VegetationPass: how many plants, how many drawn, species loaded and loading.

## Fields

| Field | Type | Meaning |
|---|---|---|
| `plants` | `uint32_t` | Plant entities |
| `drawn` | `uint32_t` | instances drawn on the desktop target |
| `triangles` | `uint32_t` | triangles drawn |
| `species_loaded` | `uint32_t` | species in GPU memory |
| `species_loading` | `uint32_t` | asked for and not drawn yet: plants are missing |

## Notes

Emplaced by VegetationPass; read by the debug menu and by captures (they wait for species_loading == 0).

## Systems that touch it

Read only by: CameraWalk, Capture, DebugMenu. Written by: vegetation. Created by: vegetation. Destroyed by: —.

| System | Kind | Scope | Access | Where | What it does with it |
|---|---|---|---|---|---|
| [CameraWalk](../systems/CameraWalk.md) | system | Host | **read** | tick (vegetationReady) | species_loading == 0 (true without it) |
| [DebugMenu](../systems/DebugMenu.md) | system | Host | **read** | tick | plants, species loaded / loading shown |
| [Capture](../systems/service-Capture.md) | service | Host | **read** | due (vegetationReady) | species_loading |
| [vegetation](../systems/pass-vegetation.md) | pass | Host | **write+create** | constructor, update | Plants, drawn, triangles, species loaded and loading. |

## Side effects of those systems

- **[CameraWalk](../systems/CameraWalk.md)**
  - Log lines "CameraWalk : from x z heading ..." (plan), soil / herds scores, and each herd it turns to.
  - profile::message("CameraWalk : started") when the route is made and ("CameraWalk : finished") at the end: tools/profile_run.py --between cuts on them; DY_FRAME_NAMED("Walk") marks every frame of the walk; CPU zone "Route the walk".
  - Reads species geometry files through VegetationLibrary::loadSpecies / loadGeometry (once per species, main thread).
  - With "exit", ends the process at the end of the walk (Input::EXIT).
- **[Capture](../systems/service-Capture.md)**
  - Reads the capture script (constructor; Game::start also reads its scene and vars with readScene).
  - Pushes SDL key, mouse button and motion events (sendInput) that InputSys reads the same frame; sets ImGui's MousePos; with hide_ui sets ImGui's style alpha to 0.
  - Creates capture_dir and writes <capture_dir>/<shot>.png (stb_image_write) from the renderer's readback; logs each shot and late shots.
  - Fails the run (Game::start returns 1) when a shot waits more than 1200 frames for the terrain or a PNG cannot be written; a late sequence frame delays the ones after it.
- **[DebugMenu](../systems/DebugMenu.md)**
  - One ImGui window "Dynamical" (needs UI before it).
  - Changing the soil or grass height-map parameters makes SoilMaps / GrassPass bake their per-chunk maps again (they watch RenderSettings).
  - Creates torch entities and dynamic boxes (Jolt bodies through RigidBodySys) on button presses; destroys every PointLight entity on "No torches".
- **[vegetation](../systems/pass-vegetation.md)**
  - Loads species geometry and textures on taskflow workers (silent_async, 6 at a time); uploads buffers and textures, allocates descriptor sets.
  - Logs each species loaded, errors for species and textures that fail.
  - With ray tracing gives meshes and textures to the rays (RayMeshes).
  - Records the plant draws and the far volume boxes of both targets; the destructor waits for running jobs.
